doc.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Early bands and the road to New York
title: Benny Carew's territory band with Lucky Thompson and Wardell Gray
summary: Jones worked with drummer-singer Benny Carew's band, which also had Wardell Gray and Lucky Thompson.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: There is a lot of dust – and just about every biography of you, and some jazz encyclopedias, they talk about your work with territory bands. I want to mention one name, Jimmy Rashell.
Jimmy Rashell. I never worked with him, but I worked with Benny Carew. By the way, Wardell Grey and Lucky Thompson also worked with that same band.
The Carew band or the Rashell band?
The Carew band or the Territory Band?
The Territory Band. Right the Carew band. Benny Carew was also a drummer and a singer. By the way, there was a Carew that worked with the Minneapolis baseball team.

Yes, he was a distant relative. They were related. Benny was a good drummer, and also a good singer. He was the flashy type. You know, throwing sticks up in the air and everything. He would bounce his sticks off the floor… Lucky Thompson and Wardell were in that same band. He had a good band. Are you familiar with Wardell and Lucky?
